§6Machine type: §aMagical Energy Absorber§r

This is where the ultimate destiny of the Dragon's Children lies.
With the help of the Magic Egg, it draws in endless magical power as effortlessly as a soul-sucking sorcerer.
Every dragon egg generates 1A EV & every creeper's generates 1A HV.
Infinity egg generates 2A IV, but you can put only one for one each piece you add.
But quantitative change leads to qualitative change,
Every 2^n pieces give 2% max efficiency bonus, and every infinity egg gives 1%.
You can also put nothing on the egg pos, but every empty pos decreases 5% max efficiency.
Warm-up process for 0.01% per second as base, each pair of Dragon Eggs add 0.01% but limit for 50 pairs, each Infinity Egg add 1% with no limits.
The process will take about 3 hours if put Creeper Eggs only, but who really care about?
Whether it is the Dragon Egg, Creeper Egg, or the Egg of Infinity, only their presence can drive the full circulation of power.

[note]Structure[/note]: Trinium Frame Boxes; Iridium Frame Boxes; Photonic Intensifiers (optional speed upgrades); the casings in the optional task.
Use a Hologram Projector (or the NEI structure preview) to see and auto-build the structure.
